build.buildCommand: cd posqrcode && corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.33.0 --activate && pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter @bear360/shared build && pnpm --filter @bear360/api prisma:generate && pnpm --filter @bear360/api build

deploy.startCommand: cd posqrcode && pnpm --filter @bear360/api prisma:migrate:deploy || true && node apps/api/dist/main.js
